name: harbor
description: Harbor is a small content-site design system: Figma tokens, Foundation, Storybook, accessibility, and visual regression.

scripts.test:a11y: npm run build-storybook && playwright test tests/a11y.spec.js tests/behavior.spec.js
scripts.test:visual: npm run build-storybook && playwright test tests/visual.spec.js
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build-storybook && playwright test tests/visual.spec.js --update-snapshots
scripts.test: npm run test:figma && npm run tokens:check && npm run build-storybook && playwright test
